channel.title: Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair – Health advice
channel.description: Pharmacist-reviewed health, skincare and wellbeing advice from Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair, Broadbeach.

item.title: Acne Treatment at the Pharmacy: What Actually Helps
item.description: Acne treatment from the pharmacy: what helps, how long it takes and when to see a GP. Pharmacist tips on sunscreen and skincare for humid Gold Coast days.

item.title: Athlete’s Foot Treatment: How to Clear It for Good
item.description: Athlete's foot treatment: pharmacy antifungal options, how long to use them and when to see a GP. Tips for humid Gold Coast summers, pools and gym showers.

item.title: Bluebottle Sting Treatment: What to Do (and What Not to Do)
item.description: Stung by a bluebottle on the Gold Coast? Step-by-step first aid from Australian guidelines, myths to ignore (vinegar, urine) and when to call 000.

item.title: Common Cold Remedies: Myths, Facts and What Helps
item.description: Common cold remedies that ease symptoms, cold vs flu, why antibiotics don't help, and safe options for kids. Advice from our Pacific Fair pharmacists.

item.title: Constipation Relief: A Pharmacist’s Checklist
item.description: Constipation relief that works: fibre, fluids, toilet position and laxative types explained, plus tips for Gold Coast holidays and when to see a GP.

item.title: Dandruff Treatment: Your Questions Answered
item.description: Dandruff treatment explained: causes, medicated shampoos, home tips and when to see a GP. Handy advice for Gold Coast swimmers who wash their hair often.

item.title: Dry Skin Remedies: A Pharmacist’s Checklist
item.description: Dry skin remedies that work: shower habits, choosing a moisturiser and when to see a GP. Tips for skin dried out by Gold Coast sun, salt water and air-con.

item.title: Haemorrhoids Treatment: Myths, Facts and Home Care
item.description: Haemorrhoids treatment at home and from the pharmacy, why drinking water matters in Gold Coast heat, and when any bleeding means you should see a GP.

item.title: Headache Relief: Your Questions Answered
item.description: Headache relief explained: tension-type triggers like Gold Coast heat and dehydration, safe pain relief, medication-overuse headache and when to call 000.

item.title: Heartburn Relief and GORD: What Actually Helps
item.description: Heartburn relief from our Broadbeach pharmacists: common triggers, eating and sleep tips, pharmacy reflux medicines, and when chest pain means call 000.

item.title: How to Treat a Cut or Scrape: Step-by-Step First Aid
item.description: How to treat a cut or scrape: stop bleeding, clean, cover and spot infection. Plus tetanus advice and red flags for Gold Coast beach and holiday injuries.

item.title: Mouth Ulcer Treatment: Home Care and When to Worry
item.description: Mouth ulcer treatment: saltwater rinses, soft foods (skip the salty beach chips), pharmacy gels, and when an ulcer needs a Gold Coast dentist or GP.

item.title: Nail Fungus Treatment: Myths, Facts and What Works
item.description: Nail fungus treatment myths vs facts: pharmacy nail lacquers, when you need a GP and why it takes months. Foot tips for humid Gold Coast summers and pools.

item.title: Scabies Treatment Australia: Your Questions Answered
item.description: Scabies treatment in Australia: pharmacy and GP options, treating your whole household, washing bedding, and advice for Gold Coast share houses.

item.title: Migraine Relief: What to Do When an Attack Starts
item.description: Migraine relief step by step: spot the warning signs, act early, know your triggers like Gold Coast storms and glare, and when a headache means call 000.

item.title: Sun Safety on the Gold Coast: Why UV Is a Year-Round Job
item.description: Gold Coast UV hits 3+ every day, even in winter. Simple sun safety for beach days, the school run and car parks, plus when to get a spot checked by a GP.

item.title: Sunburn Treatment: What to Do After Too Much Sun
item.description: Sunburn treatment step by step: cool, soothe and protect burnt skin, and know when to see a GP. Pharmacist tips for Gold Coast beach days and holidays.

item.title: Trouble Sleeping Tips From Your Local Pharmacist
item.description: Trouble sleeping tips for hot, humid Gold Coast nights: routines, caffeine timing, when to see a GP and how our Pacific Fair pharmacists can help.

item.title: Sprain vs Strain: What’s the Difference and What to Do
item.description: Sprain vs strain explained, with RICE and No HARM first aid for ankles rolled on Gold Coast sand, plus the red flags that mean a GP visit or X-ray.
